changeSet.sql:
CREATE TABLE diary_entry_goal ( id INTEGER PRIMARY KEY AUTOINCREMENT, created_at TIMESTAMP NOT NULL, updated_at TIMESTAMP NOT NULL, user_id BIGINT NOT NULL, day_goal_id BIGINT NOT NULL, position INTEGER NOT NULL, when_started TIMESTAMP NOT NULL, when_ended TIMESTAMP NOT NULL, expected_duration_min INTEGER NOT NULL, name VARCHAR(120) NOT NULL, mood SMALLINT, description VARCHAR(1000), current_entry_id BIGINT, completeness INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0, CONSTRAINT fk_entry_goal_user FOREIGN KEY (user_id) REFERENCES users (id), CONSTRAINT fk_entry_goal_day FOREIGN KEY (day_goal_id) REFERENCES day_goal (id) ON DELETE CASCADE, CONSTRAINT fk_entry_goal_current_entry FOREIGN KEY (current_entry_id) REFERENCES diary_entry (id) );
CREATE INDEX idx_entry_goal_user ON diary_entry_goal (user_id); CREATE INDEX idx_entry_goal_day ON diary_entry_goal (day_goal_id); CREATE INDEX idx_entry_goal_range ON diary_entry_goal (when_started, when_ended); CREATE INDEX idx_entry_goal_entry ON diary_entry_goal (current_entry_id);
